name: Olivier Gendebien
features: olive skin, dark wavy hair worn back, dark deep-set eyes, lean angular face, slim build, cool measured expression
bio: Seventh overall in the 1955 Mille Miglia with Jacques Washer in a 300 SL, second in the GT class behind Fitch. One of the greatest sports car drivers there has been: four wins at Le Mans (1958, 1960, 1961, 1962), three Targa Florios and three Sebrings. He raced in Formula One on and off from 1955 to 1961 for eighteen points and two podiums, and was appointed to Belgium's Order of the Crown in 1998, the year he died.
